hyperedges.label: PIX fura-fila sandbox validation flow (Fase 1 -> Fase 2)

nodes.label: barId hardcoded as a constant, never from query string
nodes.norm_label: barid hardcoded as a constant, never from query string
nodes.rationale: Unlike production (which takes ?bar=citta from the URL), the sandbox front-end fixes BAR_ID = 'teste-pix-sandbox' as a code constant. Deliberate: this sandbox runs against the same live Firebase project (karaokebar-7a67f) that may hold real bar data, so no code path may accept an arbitrary barId from a user-controlled source.

nodes.label: Webhook Idempotency (/pagamentosProcessados)
nodes.rationale: /pagamentosProcessados/{paymentId} is only written after the queue reorder succeeds, so a webhook resent before that point just repeats the concurrency retry rather than double-applying the fura-fila effect — guards against Mercado Pago's at-least-once webhook delivery causing duplicate reorders.

nodes.label: Optimistic concurrency via REST ETag (transaction() substitute)
nodes.norm_label: optimistic concurrency via rest etag (transaction() substitute)
nodes.rationale: Production uses the Firebase client SDK's .transaction() on the whole fila array to avoid lost updates from simultaneous writes, but the REST API used by the Cloudflare Worker has no transaction() (it needs a persistent WebSocket). The Worker instead does GET with X-Firebase-ETag, locates the pedido by id, PUTs the whole array back with If-Match, and retries on 412 — an optimistic-concurrency equivalent, implemented in worker/src/firebase.js's furarFila().

nodes.label: Fase 1 vs Fase 2: fila schema (array vs map)
nodes.norm_label: fase 1 vs fase 2: fila schema (array vs map)
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 assumed /bares/{barId}/karaoke/fila was a map keyed by name (invented, never validated against production). Phase 2 audited the real karaoke-bar-v2 production app and found the true schema is an array of pedidos identified by a numeric id (Date.now()+random), each carrying vezesCantadas/timestamp/timestampFila/youtubeUrl. This changed the Worker's /criar-cobranca contract from a 'nomeId' lookup to a 'pedidoId' lookup, and made the Phase 1 frontend obsolete.

nodes.label: Webhook Signature Validation (HMAC-SHA256)
nodes.rationale: The Mercado Pago webhook's x-signature header is validated via HMAC-SHA256 (Web Crypto) against the documented manifest string (id/request-id/ts). An invalid signature returns 401 and nothing is written to Firebase — prevents forged payment-approved webhooks from reordering the queue.

nodes.label: ordenarFila() (v2 sandbox, extended for Furar Fila)
nodes.norm_label: ordenarfila() (v2 sandbox, extended for furar fila)

nodes.label: PIX "Fura-fila" (pay-to-skip-queue)
nodes.rationale: Lets a customer pay via PIX (R$10 default, PRECO_FURAR_FILA_CENTAVOS server-side only, never client-supplied) to jump to the top of the queue. On approved payment the Worker sets furouFila=true and a server-timestamped furouFilaOrdem so ordenarFila() can rank paid requests first, tie-broken by payment order — validated end-to-end without needing a real credit card via Mercado Pago Sandbox + a Cloudflare Worker webhook.

nodes.label: Priorização por Rodadas (fairness algorithm)
nodes.rationale: Whoever has sung fewer times gets priority; ties broken by arrival order. Chosen so the queue feels fair over a night rather than strict FIFO, and to discourage one person hogging turns by submitting many requests.

nodes.label: Persistência via localStorage (client-only fallback)
nodes.rationale: Queue/history/count/lock state is kept in the browser's localStorage as a no-backend fallback so the app works without a server; trade-off explicitly noted: data is lost on cache clear or incognito mode. Superseded at runtime by Firebase Realtime Database sync when available.

nodes.label: Client-Side Admin/DJ Password Gate
nodes.rationale: A plaintext password constant (SENHA_ADMIN) compared in the browser, with the pass/fail flag kept in sessionStorage, guards the Admin/DJ tab. The code comments acknowledge this is not secure for real secrets and should be replaced before production use.

nodes.label: Bloqueio Automático por Horário Limite
nodes.rationale: The queue auto-closes once the estimated finish time (queue length × 5 min/song) would cross 23:00, so the bar doesn't keep accepting requests it can't actually play before closing; a manual DJ override exists for early/late closes.
